title: Personal Training Packages: the unlimited-tier session grant at activation
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states how the tier's own granted session count is read for the unlimited tier at activation.

## Rule
Where the tier's own listed session count denotes unlimited use, the package is credited with unlimited use at activation, subject to that tier's own weekly fair-use cap, rather than any fixed whole number of sessions. Where the tier's own listed session count is a specific whole number, the package is credited with that specific number of sessions at activation.

## Points of judgement
Only the tier whose own listed session count denotes unlimited use is credited with unlimited use; every other tier is credited with its own fixed, specific number of sessions. This distinction is read directly from the tier's own listed session count and applies identically at every activation on that tier, regardless of any signing bonus that may also apply.
